groups.label: Control
groups.description: Console access and server power controls.

permissions.label: Console
permissions.description: View server output and send console commands.

permissions.label: Start
permissions.description: Start the server when it is offline.

permissions.label: Stop
permissions.description: Stop a running server.

permissions.label: Restart
permissions.description: Restart the server.

groups.label: User
groups.description: Manage access for people helping with this server.

permissions.label: View users
permissions.description: View people with access to this server.

permissions.label: Create users
permissions.description: Add and invite people with permissions you also have.

permissions.label: Update users
permissions.description: Change a subuser's permissions, within your own access.

permissions.label: Delete users
permissions.description: Revoke a subuser's access to this server.

groups.label: Files
groups.description: Browse and manage the server's files.

permissions.label: List files
permissions.description: View folders and file information.

permissions.label: Read and download files
permissions.description: Open file contents and download server files.

permissions.label: Create and upload files
permissions.description: Create folders and files, and upload new files.

permissions.label: Edit files
permissions.description: Change the contents of existing files.

permissions.label: Delete files
permissions.description: Move files and folders to Recycle Bin, or permanently remove recycled files.

groups.label: Backups
groups.description: Manage backup archives and automatic schedules.

permissions.label: View backups
permissions.description: View backup archives and their status.

permissions.label: Create backups
permissions.description: Create a new backup of the server's files.

permissions.label: Download backups
permissions.description: Download existing backup archives.

permissions.label: Restore backups
permissions.description: Replace a stopped server's files with a saved backup.

permissions.label: Delete backups
permissions.description: Permanently remove backup archives.

permissions.label: Manage backup schedules
permissions.description: Change automatic backup timing and retention.

permissions.label: View audit logs
permissions.description: Read and search recorded server activity.
